schema.name: _moul_version_after_delete
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER _moul_version_after_delete AFTER DELETE ON _moul
		BEGIN UPDATE _moul_version SET version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1; END

schema.name: _moul_version_after_insert
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER _moul_version_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON _moul
		BEGIN UPDATE _moul_version SET version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1; END

schema.name: _moul_version_after_update
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER _moul_version_after_update AFTER UPDATE ON _moul
		BEGIN UPDATE _moul_version SET version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1; END

schema.name: _certmagic
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _certmagic (
			key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
			value BLOB,
			modified TEXT NOT NULL,
			is_dir INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
		)

schema.name: _feature_flags
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _feature_flags (
			id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
			key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
			description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
			default_value TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'false',
			gates TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
			createdAt TEXT NOT NULL,
			updatedAt TEXT NOT NULL
		)

schema.name: _file_refs
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _file_refs (
			fileId TEXT NOT NULL,
			moul TEXT NOT NULL,
			recordId TEXT NOT NULL,
			field TEXT NOT NULL,
			PRIMARY KEY (fileId, moul, recordId, field)
		)

schema.name: _files
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _files (
			id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
			ownerMoul TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			ownerId TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			createdAt TEXT NOT NULL
		)

schema.name: _moul
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _moul (
			id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
			name TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
			type TEXT NOT NULL,
			fields TEXT NOT NULL,
			rules TEXT NOT NULL,
			createdAt TEXT NOT NULL,
			updatedAt TEXT NOT NULL
		, `email_templates` TEXT, `webhooks` TEXT)

schema.name: _moul_version
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _moul_version (
			id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
			version INTEGER NOT NULL
		)

schema.name: _realtime_tickets
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _realtime_tickets (
			id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
			authRecord TEXT,
			isAdmin INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			tokenHash TEXT,
			tokenExpiresAt TEXT,
			revealFields TEXT,
			expiresAt TEXT NOT NULL,
			createdAt TEXT NOT NULL
		)

schema.name: _requests
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _requests (
			id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
			visit_id TEXT,
			method TEXT NOT NULL,
			path TEXT NOT NULL,
			status_code INTEGER NOT NULL,
			response_time_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
			createdAt TEXT NOT NULL
		)

schema.name: _revoked_tokens
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _revoked_tokens (
			token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
			expires_at TEXT NOT NULL
		)

schema.name: _rootUsers
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _rootUsers (
			id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
			username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
			email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
			name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
			passwordHash TEXT NOT NULL,
			createdAt TEXT NOT NULL,
			updatedAt TEXT NOT NULL
		)

schema.name: _settings
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _settings (
			key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
			value TEXT NOT NULL
		)

schema.name: _visits
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _visits (
			id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
			visitor_token TEXT NOT NULL,
			user_id TEXT,
			ip TEXT,
			user_agent TEXT,
			referrer TEXT,
			referring_domain TEXT,
			landing_page TEXT,
			browser TEXT,
			os TEXT,
			device_type TEXT,
			country TEXT,
			region TEXT,
			city TEXT,
			utm_source TEXT,
			utm_medium TEXT,
			utm_term TEXT,
			utm_content TEXT,
			utm_campaign TEXT,
			started_at TEXT NOT NULL
		)

schema.name: _workers
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _workers (
			id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
			createdAt TEXT NOT NULL,
			updatedAt TEXT NOT NULL,
			state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'available',
			queue TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default',
			worker TEXT NOT NULL,
			args TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
			meta TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
			tags TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
			errors TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
			attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			max_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20,
			priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			inserted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
			scheduled_at TEXT NOT NULL,
			attempted_at TEXT,
			attempted_by TEXT,
			cancelled_at TEXT,
			completed_at TEXT,
			discarded_at TEXT
		)
